title: fix(objectql): a data driver receives the declared driver options and nothing else
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 引擎交给数据驱动的选项,现在只含 `DriverOptionsSchema` 声明的键(从 schema 读出,去掉退役墓碑 `timeout`)。`buildDriverOptions` 返回的就是这组键;find、findOne、count、aggregate、insert、update、delete(按 id 与多行)以及原始 `execute` 都把它交给驱动。hook 读到的 `input.options` 不变,仍是调用方的选项袋加上驱动选项(加法视图)。
- **为什么改:** 维护者裁决(选项 A):引擎交给驱动的只有声明的驱动选项,别无其他。沿用 #4400 把引擎选项袋做成封闭契约的做法,往下推一跳到驱动。
- **风险与回滚:** 声明键(`transaction`、`tenantId`、`tenantIds`、`timezone`、`preserveAudit`、`bypassTenantAudit`)原样到达,有对照测试;仓内驱动都只读声明键。若有第三方驱动读未声明的键,它将读不到(仓内没有)。`@objectstack/objectql` patch,spec 只改两处注释。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** ① `packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts` 的 `pickDeclaredDriverOptions`、`mergeDriverOptionsIntoHookView` 和 `buildDriverOptions` 早返回那几行;② `engine.ts` 里 find / findOne / insert / update / delete 把 `driverOptions` 交给驱动、把合并视图留给 hook 的位置。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/engine-driver-options.test.ts`,预期 `8 passed`;把 `buildDriverOptions` 里的 `pickDeclaredDriverOptions(base)` 换回 `{ ...base }` 再跑,第二个用例转红。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

The engine → driver hop is now a closed contract, one hop below the engine option bags #4400 closed: a data driver receives the keys `DriverOptionsSchema` declares and nothing else.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts`
  - `declaredDriverOptionKeys()` reads the key set off `DriverOptionsSchema.shape` on first use, minus any member that admits only absence (a `retiredKey()` tombstone, today `timeout`). It is never restated, so a key the spec declares reaches drivers with no edit here.
  - `pickDeclaredDriverOptions(bag)` cuts a bag to that set (own enumerable keys, values untouched).
  - `buildDriverOptions` starts from the declared keys of `base` instead of a copy of the whole bag, so every bag it returns is declared-only. A caller's explicit `tenantId` / `transaction` / `bypassTenantAudit` still wins, exactly as before.
  - `mergeDriverOptionsIntoHookView(callerBag, driverOptions)` builds the `after*` view of `input.options`: the caller's bag with the driver options merged on, additive as the hook PHASE contract states; the caller's own object when nothing is added; and a copy of the driver options when there is no caller bag, so the hooks' view and the driver's bag are never one object.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: `find`, `findOne`, `insert`, `update` and `delete` keep the built options in a local `driverOptions`, hand THAT to every driver call (including the reads and writes the verb makes along the way), and assign the merged view to `input.options` for hooks.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-execute-transactions.ts`: the raw `execute` door hands its driver the declared keys of its bag.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`: comment-only. The pass-through keys docblock now says the bag's declared keys are the base of the driver options.
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`: comment-only. The hook PHASE paragraph said the `after*` handler and the driver read one view; it now says the merged view is the hooks' and a driver is handed the declared keys, and it names both `buildDriverOptions` (which produces the driver's set) and `mergeDriverOptionsIntoHookView` (which merges that set into the hook view). `DriverOptionsSchema`'s doc states the hop rule.
- `.changeset/driver-options-declared-keys-only.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.test.ts` (new, 8 cases), on a recording driver double that captures the options argument as the driver receives it:

- `a data driver receives the declared driver options and nothing else`
  - the hop key set is `DriverOptionsSchema`'s declared keys, and every shape key it leaves out refuses every probe value (a tombstone);
  - `find`, `findOne`, `insert`, `update` and `delete` (by id and multi-row; `count`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany` asserted reached too) hand the driver only declared option keys;
  - the raw `execute` door hands the driver only declared option keys.
- `control: the declared keys the engine threads still reach the driver`: `transaction`, `tenantId` and `timezone` arrive on every verb; `preserveAudit` and a caller's explicit `bypassTenantAudit` arrive unchanged.
- `the after* hook view of input.options stays additive`: an `afterFind` hook still reads the caller's own keys beside the driver options; an `afterUpdate` hook still reads a key the caller passed; the merge helper answers the caller's own bag when it adds nothing, and a copy, never the driver's bag itself, when there is no caller bag.

`packages/objectql/src/engine.test.ts`: four expansion sub-read cases hold the driver's received option keys to a subset of `declaredDriverOptionKeys()`; the file-reference case reads the expansion marker at the middleware seam.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why `Clause-②: no`, no arm, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`.** No accept set moves: every engine door accepts the option bags it accepted, and `DriverOptionsSchema` is unchanged apart from its doc comment. The keys that stop reaching a driver were never declared on the driver contract (the `DriverOptions` type carries none of them, so a typed driver could not read one without a cast), and no driver in this repository reads one. What a metadata author can write does not change.
- **Why the cut is not inside the hook view.** `buildDriverOptions`'s result used to be both the driver's options and the `after*` hook view of `input.options`. Hooks in this repository read caller keys from that view after the merge (an `afterInsert` / `afterUpdate` handler reads one there), and the hook PHASE contract states the merge is additive. So the declared set is what the driver is handed, and hooks keep the additive view; the third test block pins that.
- **Undeclared keys are dropped without a sound**, as ruled: the caller's bag was already judged at the engine's own door (#4400), so nothing dropped at the hop is a caller's mistake. A dev-mode warning was considered and not added; the contract review decided against one.
- **Bulk `after*` per-row dispatches** read the same merged view as before.
- **Which doors admit the schema's other declared keys.** `insert` and the raw `execute` door hand them on when a caller sets them; `find`, `findOne`, `update` and `delete` admit only the six threaded keys at their own door (`ENGINE_DRIVER_PASSTHROUGH_KEYS`), unchanged by this PR.
- **Contract review.** PASS with no must-fix; the should-fix items are done at 6aaa0350bb (see Verification).

## Verification
